page_title: Control configuration positioning mode, positioning upload interval
page_content:
[TOC]

### Prerequisites
- A usable remote control and normal display screen

### Operation steps
1. Enter the main menu function interface, operate the direction keys and ENTER key of the remote control, enter Settings-Basic Settings-User, and set the positioning mode
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=61f7ae4339a7f7589345a6f150f98076)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=85d396395f4a01d53716dad5c80a3a8f)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=9e4b92e9f6920d8c0d2532ce1b24a5a2)

2. Enter the main menu function interface, operate the remote control direction keys and ENTER key, enter Settings--Network Settings--Mode, and set the GPS upload interval
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=feb6a70efe729a156b455a55c6e133eb)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c9713a9477b1d2b88c3b4340a9235225)
